name: @swao/module-html-portal
description: SWAO HTML Portal module (Consultant tier): the multi-page portfolio portal (buildPortalSite), the Mode B per-app static-site builder (buildModeBSite) and the coming-soon live portal server (createPortalServer). Every page is assembled through the shared @swao/publication-render leaf pipeline, so style + content parity with the single-page publication is structural (ADR-0048 modular architecture, Sprint 064 #0582 module-split stage 2; Design 058 D-PORTAL-1). The Community `publish` command stays in @swao/module-html-report and reaches buildPortalSite by host injection; this module never imports the Community sibling.
